**380 commits, 3 breaking, 1 feature.** Entry written at [CHANGELOG.md:3](CHANGELOG.md:3).

The breaking ones hid in `refactor` commits. Internal error types stopped being re-exported. The v1 export route was deleted. Expired tokens now return `401`, not `403`.

The rest is 26 fixes, folded into 8 lines. I dropped 10 `perf` commits. The three-heading rule left them no home. Say the word and I add them.

No `engines` bump landed. Docs claim a minimum Node version. Check that before you ship.
